page_title: EMP 0-3 INT | Empoli v Inter 30/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Mehdi Taremi (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
87' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes the corner.
84' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
81' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Stefan de Vrij will be replaced by Tomas Palacios (Inter).

79' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Nicolo Barella, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who beats Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.

78' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a precise pass from his teammate and sends a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, he didn't manage to aim well enough and the ball flies just narrowly wide of the right post.
77' Substitution. Junior Sambia (Empoli) has come on for Emmanuel Gyasi.
75' The game is interrupted as Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is flagged offside.
75' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
73' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and it's Lautaro Martinez (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
72' 6:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

67' 0 - 2 0:2. Davide Frattesi (Inter) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a great first-timer into the bottom left corner. What an amazing finish! Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Lautaro Martinez provided the assistance.
67' A header by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) from very close range goes straight at Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who makes a nice save.
66' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Lorenzo Colombo and he is replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Empoli).
65' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Benjamin Pavard (Inter).
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrikh Mkhitaryan departs the field of play to be replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
65' It's time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes on in place of Federico Dimarco.
64' The game is interrupted. Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
64' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
63' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Empoli was in an offside position.
62' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Inter are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
57' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) replacing Faustino Anjorin.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Liam Henderson (Empoli) is brought on as a substitute for Youssef Maleh.
54' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' A player from Inter commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
50' 0 - 1 Matteo Darmian plays a neat ball into the path of Davide Frattesi (Inter), who makes room for a shot and sends it towards the top left corner, ricocheting in off the post! 0:1.
49' One of the players from Empoli times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
49' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
48' Empoli are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
48' Davide Frattesi (Inter) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Roberto D'Aversa probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ola Solbakken (Empoli). He is replaced by Mattia De Sciglio.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Nicolo Barella (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45+2' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
45+1' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the right post. Unlucky!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marchetti had an easy-decision to make.
38' The ball possession is 30:70.
35' Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
33' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is caught offside!
33' Federico Dimarco (Inter) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach was alert and made a comfortable save.
31' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Matteo Marchetti produces a RED card from his pocket and Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) heads for an early shower!

30' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Saba Goglichidze (Empoli), but referee Matteo Marchetti must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
29' Tempers flare after Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
24' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
23' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
23' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
21' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Inter due to a handball in the build-up play.
20' Wait! Referee Matteo Marchetti has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
19' Goal! Matteo Darmian (Inter) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
16' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Marcus Thuram (Inter) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
14' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

12' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his left to save the attempt which was aimed towards the top corner. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
10' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

6' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Yann Sommer pulls off an easy save.
6' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Marcus Thuram (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
3' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will referee today's match.
